constraints: Closes only the most recently opened (innermost) unclosed element, i.e. matches SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT calls in stack (LIFO) order.
Use of this command is optional: 4D automatically adds the necessary end tags for any still-open elements when the XML document itself is closed.

Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): SAX write document lifecycle: SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT (or the ARRAYS variant) opens an element -> SAX ADD XML ELEMENT VALUE adds its content while it remains open -> SAX CLOSE XML ELEMENT closes the most recently opened element (or the document itself is closed, which auto-closes any still-open elements).
